status_rule: A required surface passes only when every required state cell passes. Missing evidence never passes.

A surface passes only when every resulting required execution passes.

surfaces.current_implementation: P47A and P47B restore original STRATEGY 902/903 Display Off and Popular Support backdrops, exact faction GID control pairs, compact 10168 legend, and supported marker families and thresholds. P48 adds a source-mapped code-built GID root and submenu with all 22 recovered commands, original faction menu icons, provisional non-support filter metrics, and a test-only 38-scenario browser matrix. P50 restores the STRATEGY 10100 through 10107 frame tiles to both menu layers and removes the invented fade. P51 removes an unsupported row-hover wash and checks source frame pixels that remain visible beneath a system window. Commit 3393d5c8 removes invented camera state and verifies the original fixed map by proving that right-drag and wheel input leave the rendered frame unchanged. The 152 muted faction/viewport probes are an implementation regression gate, not original acceptance. Unsupported special marker overlays and an invented expanded legend were withheld after independent review. Menu interior, original hover/focus states, typography, exact geometry, non-support predicates, mixed-fleet allegiance, type-specific idle facilities, original floating legend, HQ/blockade/mission/Death Star states, native equivalence, keyboard focus, and full A0 composition remain open.

surfaces.title: Pause, day, and speed controls
surfaces.current_implementation: P60 removes the replacement status bar and speed buttons. The top-strip day readout is the Game Speed control: a right-button release inside its recovered rectangle opens the five-item STRATEGY Game Menu Window (Pause, Very Slow, Slow, Medium, Fast); the original has no faster speed, so the very fast cell has no original counterpart. Pause sets the original stop day, finishes the current day, and opens the REBDLOG 412x176 Resume Game Play? alert; its checkmark or Enter resumes at the kept speed. Alt+P, Alt+NumPad+, and Alt+NumPad- follow TEXTCOMM accelerator table 11. Four muted browser sessions cover both factions at 640x480 and 1280x800. The wall-clock rate unit, menu font and background, day font source, Resume tooltip, and every A0 comparison remain open, so no cell is accepted.
